caption:
Trust in Allah: what He has is more lasting

Whatever we are given here is a short enjoyment of this world. Allah says what is with Him is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord. Let that settle your heart tonight.

Surah Ash-Shura 42:36

Send this to someone who is tired of chasing this world.

#tawakkul #trustinallah #surahshura #quranreels

Recitation: Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi
